categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates test/functional/feature_block.py to expand consensus validation test coverage.
categories.rationale: Adds functional test coverage for BIP30 validation on duplicate non-coinbase transactions, killing a surviving mutant in consensus validation. Mutation testing demonstrated that restricting BIP30 checks strictly to block.vtx[0] survived the test suite, making this worthwhile coverage for an untested consensus code path, though reasonably deferrable as it addresses no active defect.
